طَبَنٌ and ↓ طَابِنٌ Intelligent, understanding, skilled, or knowing, (S, K, * TA,) in everything: (TA:) the former is syn. with تَبِنٌ [q. v.]: (M in art. تبن:) and ↓ طُبُنَّةٌ signifies [very intelligent &c., being of a measure proper to intensive epithets; or simply] skilled, or skilful. (TA.) ＝
-A2- And for the first of these words (طَبِنٌ), see also طُبْنَةٌ.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
